articles.title: Democrats added certain consumer protection rules to CLARITY: Coinbase exec

articles.title: Google Is Building an AI Chip Just for Gemini—And Investors Already Moved On It
articles.snippet: Codenamed Frozen v2, Google's new server chip would bake part of Gemini's architecture directly into hardware for a projected 6–10x efficiency gain.
